hero.title: AmaImagery is a professional image generation platform built for creators.
hero.summary: Generate, browse history, and fine-tune your settings — all in one seamless experience designed for serious creative work.

principles.title: Why the system exists
principles.description: The interface is designed so prompt work, queue behavior, history fidelity, and interface controls all feel like parts of the same product instead of separate experiments.

unified.title: One product contract
unified.text: Generation, history, settings, and recovery work together as one unified experience rather than separate disconnected tools.

clarity.title: Operational clarity
clarity.text: Queue visibility, retries, saved metadata, and explicit states make the tool readable when real runs are happening.

premium.title: Premium interface
premium.text: Editorial surfaces and serious controls coexist so the product feels creator-grade without hiding the mechanics.

workflow.title: How the flow works
workflow.description: Each major screen owns a different job, but the product experience stays consistent from first prompt to saved result.

compose.title: Compose with intent
compose.text: Write a focused prompt, add reference guidance when needed, and keep negative constraints explicit.

runtime.title: Read the process
runtime.text: Queue status, engine progress, and recoverable errors stay visible while the generation is active.

reuse.title: Reuse what works
reuse.text: Saved history, metadata filters, and interface presets make it easier to repeat strong results without losing context.
